requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL keep the .NET OM type-system kernel semantically aligned with the Bun OM reference design for mixins, inherited attributes, aliases, validity values, and type queries.

case.given: A mixin defines attribute `created_by` and a type attaches that mixin
case.when: A caller sets `created_by` on an entity of that type
case.then: The .NET OM SHALL accept the property as a defined effective attribute

case.given: A parent type defines a required String attribute
case.when: A child type redefines that attribute as optional or as a different value type
case.then: The .NET OM SHALL reject the unsafe override

case.given: Legacy data stores a property under an attribute alias name
case.when: A caller reads or validates the canonical attribute
case.then: The .NET OM SHALL use alias fallback so renamed data remains observable

case.given: An attribute is defined with value type `Validity`
case.when: A caller sets the attribute with a supported validity-like input
case.then: The .NET OM SHALL store a Cozo validity value and pass validation

case.given: A relation is defined with `directed=false` from type A to type B
case.when: A caller links a B entity to an A entity through that relation
case.then: The .NET OM SHALL accept the link as an undirected relation endpoint match
